summary: Iteration 5: Auth system change from OTP to username/password tested. All 21 backend API tests pass (100%). All frontend features verified: admin login, employee login with role-based navigation, FY selector, connection status showing 'Synced', user management modal, change password modal, inventory stock group filter, CRM tabs.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/login - admin login with correct credentials returns token and user data
Backend: POST /api/auth/login - wrong password returns 'Invalid username or password' error
Backend: POST /api/auth/login - nonexistent user returns error
Backend: GET /api/auth/me - returns user data with valid token
Backend: GET /api/auth/me - returns 'Not authenticated' without token
Backend: GET /api/auth/users - admin can list all users
Backend: GET /api/auth/users - returns error without auth
Backend: POST /api/auth/users - admin can create employee user
Backend: POST /api/auth/users - duplicate username returns error
Backend: POST /api/auth/change-password - wrong current password rejected
Backend: POST /api/auth/reset-password - admin can reset user password
Backend: POST /api/auth/reset-password - nonexistent user returns error
Backend: GET /api/tally/status - shows connected status with company name
Backend: GET /api/inventory/items - returns items with stock_groups array
Backend: GET /api/inventory/items - stock_group filter works
Backend: GET /api/inventory/summary - returns summary stats
Backend: Employee login returns role='employee'
Backend: Employee cannot access /api/auth/users (admin only)
Backend: GET /api/customers/outstanding - returns customer list
Backend: GET /api/customers/followups - returns followups with created_by fields
Backend: GET /api/customers/targets - returns targets list
Frontend: Login page shows username/password form (not OTP)
Frontend: Admin login shows all 8 nav tabs: Dashboard, Inventory, Sales, CRM, Analytics, AI Reports, Salesman, Setup
Frontend: Employee login shows only 3 nav tabs: Inventory, Sales, CRM
Frontend: FY selector dropdown visible in nav bar with FY 2026-27
Frontend: Connection status shows 'Synced' (green)
Frontend: User menu dropdown shows Change Password, Manage Users (admin), Logout
Frontend: User Management modal shows users with Reset PW and Delete options
Frontend: Change Password modal has Current Password, New Password, Confirm fields
Frontend: Inventory page has Stock Group filter dropdown
Frontend: Inventory table has Stock Group column
Frontend: CRM page has Outstanding, Follow-ups, Targets, Payment Behavior tabs
Frontend: Follow-ups show OVERDUE badge (red) for past dates
Frontend: New followups store created_by and created_by_name fields
seed_data_creation: Test followup created for Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd with created_by=admin to verify the feature.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth changed from email OTP to username/password. Admin user seeded from .env (ADMIN_USERNAME=admin, ADMIN_PASSWORD=admin123). JWT token returned in login response and set as httpOnly cookie. Role-based navigation: admin sees all 8 tabs, employee sees only Inventory/Sales/CRM. User management modal allows admin to create/delete users and reset passwords. Followups now track created_by and created_by_name. Connection status shows 'Synced' when agent has synced data.

mocked_apis.Tally XML Connection: Mock data from TallyClient when no real sync data
